tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi bstod pa bzhugs so// dpal

'phags pa rin po ches mdzad chen nam mkha'i mdog gi mdangs ldan zhing*// dus mtha'i sprin ltar hūm̐ sgra 'brug stong chem// 'bar ba'i rdo rjes bgegs kyi klad 'gems pa// phyag na rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// srid gsum yig rnying las so/ mkha' dbyings dag pa'i thugs// char sprin sku lus dang 'grogs nas// hūm̐ phaṭa 'brug gi nga ro yis// log 'dren 'dul mdzad dpa' bor 'dud/ ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsang ba kun gyi bdag /mthu stobs thogs med badz+ra hi ra kas// sa gsum log 'dren 'byung po ji snyed kun// phye mar 'dul mdzad lag na rdo rjer bstod// khyod sku srod kyi mkha' dbyings me chen gyis// 'khyud 'dra gtum chen bgegs kyi steng na dpa'// zhal gcig phyag bzhi rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs// dran pas bdud dpung ma lus 'joms la bstod// dbyar rnga 'bum gyi snyems pa 'phrog byed pa'i// hūm̐ phaṭa nga ros stong gsum rab g.yo zhing*// dgyes pa'i bzhad sgras rnal 'byor thos 'dzin la// sngon med bdud rtsi stsol la phyag 'tshal bstod// spros pa'i mtshan ma dbyings su sim pa las// zab zhi spros bral 'dus ma byas pa'i thugs// dmigs med snying rjes 'gog pa'i mtha' mnan pa// mi gnas ye shes bsam mi khyab la bstod// ma 'ongs rnam par 'joms pa'i bskal pa la// byang chub chen po brnyes pa'i tshul ston pa'i// sems dpa' che khyod gnod sbyin ma lus pa'i// rigs kyi bdag por gyur la phyag 'tshal bstod// khyod la cha tsam bstod pa'i bsod nams kyis// bdag cag 'khor bcas dus kun rjes bzung nas// nad gdon 'byung po'i 'tshe ba ji snyed pa// mtha' dag zhi zhing bsrung bar mdzad du gsol// mthun rkyen tshe bsod dpal dang 'byor pa sogs// legs pa'i yon tan thams cad dbyar mtsho ltar// 'phel zhing rgyas nas thub pas rab bsngags pa'i// dge mtshan lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol// mdor na sgo gsum bgyi pa gang lags pa// chos min spyod pas rab tu dben gyur cing*// thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa'i go 'phang mchog

/bde blag nyid du thob par mdzad du gsol// zhes pa'ang mchog sprul thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' phebs bzhin gzims 'og sprul ming pa byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags kyis bris pa maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// //gur nas gsungs pa'i yi ge brgya pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha dṛ dho me bha wa/ su to sh+yo me bha wa/ su po sh+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sha shwa to me bha wa/ hṛ da yam+me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa/ badz+rī bha wa mahā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
